name: Unsourced — AI Bot Monitor
author: unsourcedapp

sections.description:
AI bots like GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and others scrape your content to train models and generate answers. They often skip JavaScript entirely — making standard analytics invisible to their visits.

Unsourced — AI Bot Monitor runs server-side inside WordPress. It checks the User-Agent on every request, identifies known AI crawlers, and sends a non-blocking report to your Unsourced dashboard. Your visitors see zero impact on page load time.

What it detects:
* GPTBot (OpenAI)
* ChatGPT-User
* ClaudeBot (Anthropic)
* anthropic-ai
* PerplexityBot
* CCBot (Common Crawl)
* Google-Extended
* Bytespider (ByteDance)
* cohere-ai
* Diffbot
* Amazonbot
* YouBot
* Meta-ExternalAgent
* Applebot-Extended
* And more — updated with every release

Requirements:
* An Unsourced account — free 14-day trial at unsourced.app
* Your site must be verified in your Unsourced dashboard before events are recorded

External Services

This plugin sends data to Unsourced (https://unsourced.app), an external service that logs and displays AI bot activity for your site. A connection to this service is required for the plugin to function.

What data is transmitted:

  • Your site URL
  • The URL of the page being visited by the bot
  • The detected bot name and raw User-Agent string
  • The visitor IP address

When data is sent:

Only when a request matches a known AI bot signature AND a valid Unsourced API key has been configured in the plugin settings. Human visitors generate no data transmission.

Service links:

  • Website: https://unsourced.app
  • Terms of Service: https://unsourced.app/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://unsourced.app/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin in your WordPress admin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Settings → Unsourced
  4. Paste your API key (found in your Unsourced dashboard under Settings → WordPress Plugin)
  5. Click Test Connection to confirm everything is working
sections.faq:
Does this slow down my site?

No. Detection happens in a lightweight PHP hook. The report is sent as a non-blocking background request — your page renders immediately without waiting for it.

Does this block AI bots?

No. Unsourced is a monitoring tool, not a firewall. Bots are recorded and reported but not blocked. Use your robots.txt or a WAF if you want to restrict access.

Do I need a paid Unsourced plan?

No — Unsourced offers a free 14-day trial with full access. After the trial, a subscription is required to continue recording events.

My site isn’t on WordPress.com — will this work?

Yes. This plugin is for self-hosted WordPress (WordPress.org). WordPress.com managed hosting does not support third-party plugins.
